entries.placement: Best in Breed (BIR) both days — 2nd & 3rd Best in Show (BIS)
entries.show: Rättvik Hundutställning — Dalarnas Älghundklubb
entries.description: **Rättvik hundutställning** is the largest and most important show in Sweden dedicated to älghundar, run by Dalarnas Älghundklubb in central Sweden — ideally placed for champion dogs from across Sweden and further afield. To win **Best in Breed (BIR) on both days** is an outstanding achievement, and we are so proud of **Klippets Tirhild (Elsa)**. On Saturday she added **3rd Best in Show**; on Sunday she went one better with **2nd Best in Show**.

entries.placement: Best in Breed (BIR) — 3rd & Final Danish Certificate — CACIB — Crufts Qualification
entries.show: Danish Kennel Club International Show — Vejen (Day 3)
entries.description: **Klippets Tirhild is now a Danish Show Champion** — the third and final Danish Certificate needed for the title, won on the third and final day in Vejen, alongside Best in Breed, a CACIB, and qualification for Crufts. The judge's critique noted excellent type, a correct feminine head, excellent neck and topline, correct angulation, and a beautiful colour and temperament.
